input: How long do I have to get a full refund?
expected_output: You can request a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date.
context: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date.

input: Can I get a refund on a gift card?
context: Final-sale items, gift cards, and digital downloads are non-refundable.

input: How long does it take for my refund to arrive after I send the item back?
expected_output: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item is inspected.
context: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item is inspected.

input: I want to return an item 45 days after it was delivered. Will I get my money back?
expected_output: No full refund is available after 30 days. Between 30 and 60 days after delivery you are eligible for store credit only.
context: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date. After 30 days, purchases are eligible for store credit only, up to 60 days after delivery.

input: How much does express shipping cost and how fast is it?
expected_output: Express shipping costs $14.99 and takes 1-2 business days.
context: Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $14.99.

input: Who pays customs duties on international orders?
expected_output: The customer pays customs duties and import taxes on international orders.
context: Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the customer.

input: Does the warranty cover water damage?
expected_output: No. The 1-year limited warranty covers manufacturing defects only; water damage is not covered.
context: All electronics include a 1-year limited warranty from the date of purchase that covers manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, water damage, and normal wear and tear are not covered.

input: How can I extend my warranty and what does it cost?
expected_output: You can buy an extended warranty plan for $29.99 that adds 2 more years of coverage. It must be purchased within 30 days of the original purchase.
context: An extended warranty plan adds 2 additional years of coverage for $29.99. It must be purchased within 30 days of the original purchase.

input: What happens if I enter the wrong password too many times?
expected_output: After 5 failed login attempts your account is locked for 15 minutes. You can unlock it immediately with the link in the password reset email.
context: After 5 failed login attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes. Customers can unlock it immediately by using the link in the password reset email.
